summary: Hooks night for the geography channel: re-read the five reference openings against ours, added our own first-line numbers to the claim-hook challenger, and added 3 topics (Russia's size, Singapore's wealth, Oman's enclave inside the UAE).
why: Each new topic has a breakout reference (53x, 10x, 17x its channel's subscribers) and a new category, so it can be planned at once. The Greenland Short, which opens on a contradiction you can see on the map, holds 74.7% viewed against 48-55% for plain 'Why did/What if' openers, but that's 3 Shorts, so it's evidence for the queued test, not a change.

findings.title: Our best opener is a visible contradiction
findings.detail: 'Greenland sits next to Canada, yet belongs to Denmark' 74.7% viewed; Dinorwig 48%, Suez 55%. Added to geo-claim-hook's evidence.

findings.title: Russia's expansion: 2.84M on a 53.6K channel
findings.detail: How Russia got So Big (Mihul Rawat); now the top of our feed at 8.6.

findings.title: Singapore as a place story: 1.29M on 125K
findings.detail: Tests the place_resources kind with a map answer: every lane through one strait.
